name: Hostinger
description: Hostinger lets agents read and manage websites, domains, DNS records, and VPS instances in the signed-in Hostinger account. Each user signs in to their own Hostinger account through the browser.

prompts.text: List my domains and show which ones expire in the next 60 days.
Show the DNS records for my main domain.
What is the status and plan of each of my VPS instances?

apps.name: Hostinger
apps.description: Hosting, domains, DNS, and VPS management, over Hostinger's MCP server with browser sign-in.
